about.title: The Meaning Behind Flingo
about.lead: Flingo Academy is more than just a name. It represents our founders, our educators, and our core belief that language creates global opportunities.

items.title: Louis

items.title: Language, Connection & Exchange
items.desc: Building bridges between Asia, Europe, and the world through communication.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.text: To help students communicate confidently in English through engaging, practical, and personalized online education.

list.name: Teacher F
list.desc: A licensed professional teacher and experienced ESL educator, combining classroom and online teaching to help students from all cultures build real communication skills. As part of Flingo Academy's founding team, also helps shape our teaching methods and grow a global learning community — making every lesson feel dynamic, supportive, and purposeful.

list.name: Louis (路易)
list.desc: A dedicated business partner and co-founder, Louis brings a native understanding of the needs of Chinese learners and families to Flingo Academy. He leads business development, client relations, operations, and strategic planning, building bridges between students, parents, and teachers so more learners can access quality English education.

bios.teacher-cherry: A dedicated English instructor with 20 years of experience teaching learners of all ages — from children and teenagers to corporate professionals. Cherry tailors every lesson to each student's pace, goals, and background, creating a supportive environment where they feel confident to reach their milestones.
bios.teacher-diza: An ESL teacher with 18 years of experience, including over a decade helping students from Korea, China, and Spain reach their language goals — both in office-based schools and flexible home-based teaching. Diza specializes in making English accessible and engaging for every learner, adapting to the unique challenges of each region.
